args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use the application configuration's public URL instead of `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` directly (or ensure `BASE_URL` reads from config) so that password reset emails point to the correct production domain rather than falling back to localhost.
args.title: Use configured public URL for password reset email links
